description: UAE ADGM Public Register Scraper - Company Data. Scrape the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) public register: company name, registration number, status, type, classification, incorporation date, address and trade names. Search by name, identifier or trade name. No API key. Advanced fields beyond this schema are also accepted (regdata_describe lists them).

maxItems.description: Optional cap on billed dataset items returned.

maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of entities to extract per search query. 0 means no limit (fetch all matches).
maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max results per query

minIntervalMs.description: Polite delay between requests to the register. 350ms is a safe default.
minIntervalMs.title: Min interval between requests (ms)

pageSize.description: How many results to fetch per request (1-100). Larger pages are faster; the default is fine for most runs.
pageSize.title: Page size

searchQueries.description: Entity names, registration numbers or trade names to search the ADGM public register for. Each query returns all matching entities (paginated up to the limit below).
searchQueries.title: Search queries

name: regdata_uae_adgm_public_register
